verification_criteria: Deterministic integration tests demonstrate the ordered pipeline and an Advice V2 artifact result.
Configuration tests cover defaults, normalization, legacy hybrid mapping, replay isolation and fingerprints.
Data tests verify columns, ordering, timeframe coverage, degradation and current-price alignment.
Tests cover success, confirmed-empty, timeout, unavailable and source-policy behavior.
Fixed-clock tests cover fresh, stale, closed-market, future-data and timezone boundaries.
Deterministic fixtures cover normal, inverse, boundary, insufficient-history and no-future-data cases.
Advice tests cover aligned bullish, aligned bearish, conflicting and unavailable scenarios and reject V1 execution semantics.
Contract tests assert every required field, cardinality and evidence reference.
Boundary tests cover BUY and SELL geometry, missing evidence, missing checklist and audit degradation.
Tests cover higher-timeframe conflict, isolated levels, absent targets and stale data.
Mock-client tests cover success, transport failure, invalid JSON, retry exhaustion and telemetry.
Tests inject changed numbers, invented setup fields and malformed output and verify deterministic fallback.
Unit and sample-export regression tests verify required and prohibited fields.
Archive tests cover success, failure, atomic write, index, transfer and pruning.
Compatibility fixtures cover V2, legacy reconstruction, missing payloads and incompatible archives without new fetch or LLM calls.
UI helper tests and manual acceptance cover navigation, generation, replay and advice presentation.
Component tests and manual review verify disclosure and audit-detail accessibility.
Configuration tests and secret scans verify defaults, URL sanitization and controlled examples.
Fault-injection tests cover timeout, empty result, invalid JSON, HTTP errors and partial external data.
Report, progress and archive tests verify stable and complete metadata.
The declared commands complete with zero blocking failure.
Configuration and trace checks report no missing path, orphan identifier or dependency mismatch.
